gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement p5 prints Transfers in General 11,786 + Street 107,200 = 118,986 and Transfers out Street (478). Detail: General Fund departments combining statement p14 prints per department General (82,644) and Fire 20,800 + Park 39,342 + Cemetery 10,500 + Library 20,288 + Community Building 3,500 = 94,430 (net 11,786 = statement General column); Street budget schedule prints one net 'Transfers from other funds' 106,722 (= 107,200 - 478). Positive detail 94,430 + 106,722 = 201,152 vs 118,986: gap 82,166 = 82,644 transferred between General Fund departments (gross on the departmental schedule, netted in the statement's General column) less the 478 Street transfer out that the Street schedule nets into its 106,722. All printed and correctly signed; no fix.

Same cause: detail out = General department (82,644) (p14), the only negative transfer line; statement out = Street (478) (p5). The 82,644 is paid to other General Fund departments (netted within the statement's General column, which shows only Transfers in 11,786), and the Street (478) is netted inside the Street schedule's 106,722. 82,644 - 478 = 82,166 = gap. No fix.

No business-type schedule; the Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds (p7) prints Electric, Water, Sewer and Apartments Fund columns. JSON receipts = Sales 947,044 + Other revenue 25,701 + Interest income 8,104 + Grant and contribution income 150,000 = 1,130,849. Added: Electric 721,557 + 20,947 + 4,263 = 746,767; Water 180,067 + 4,128 + 1,473 + 150,000 = 335,668; Sewer 45,420 + 626 + 2,066 = 48,112; Apartments 302. Total 1,130,849 (gap 0).
